responsibility: Defines the primary C-SKY target macros, architectural constants, and backend policy settings used throughout GCC code generation for this port. It establishes register and mode predicates, constant-range tests backing constraints and predicates, default CPU selection, feature tests for architecture/FPU/TLS/casesi behavior, calling-convention and EH register macros, jump-table emission rules, trampoline sizes, operation cost policies, and many other target properties that parameterize generic GCC code and the C-SKY machine description.
same_name_distinction: This is the target configuration header for the C-SKY port, providing preprocessor macros, predicates, constants, and target property definitions consumed across GCC and by the machine description. Unlike csky.cc it does not implement hook bodies, unlike csky.md it does not describe instructions or RTL expanders, and unlike csky.opt it does not declare user-visible -m options.
